static_traits.name: Zhang Kai
static_traits.family_status: Adopted in infancy; has six siblings; adoptive father works at HP
static_traits.social_status: Relationships with siblings affected by frequently canceling or postponing visits; has some siblings and friends to talk with, but has not yet discussed the extent of Anxiety in depth
static_traits.medical_history: No major physical illness; has not yet received psychotherapy; Anxiety and Fear related to travel/the future appearing in stressful situations in the past

basic_info.main_problem: My Fear of the future, especially due to worrying about frequent flight delays, leading me to fear traveling to visit siblings.
basic_info.core_demands: Fear and Anxiety related to travel becoming hard to bear, affecting my mental health and relationships, prompting me to seek counseling.
growth_experiences: Adopted in infancy, Fear of the future and uncertainty persisting since then; currently has six siblings, adoptive father works at HP, long prone to worries about uncertainty in situations involving family visits and travel.

core_beliefs: The future is uncontrollable and full of threats

special_situations.event: Arranged the itinerary to visit siblings, looked up flight and weather information, saw reports of 'frequent flight delays'
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: As long as there is a possibility of delay, I cannot arrive on time, will end up in trouble
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Thorough planning: repeatedly studying flights, weather, and details, hoping to control the outcome through perfect arrangements
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: No matter how I plan, will still be late, may not make it at all

special_situations.event: Near departure day, preparing to head to the airport
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Once any uncertain factor appears, things will get worse, I will be stuck at the airport and unable to control anything
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Canceling or postponing trips to avoid stress and uncertainty
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Flights will surely be delayed, I will be stuck at the airport, very helpless

special_situations.event: Siblings invite him to visit and set a specific date
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: Only arriving on time exactly as planned counts as success; otherwise it is failure and will damage relationships
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Planning trips to near perfection; if feeling unable to ensure punctuality, then simply not departing
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: If anything unexpected happens, this family visit will be a complete failure

special_situations.event: Reviews past or media information about flight delays
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: The negative detail of having experienced delays means the future will be the same
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Focuses only on possible risks and bad situations, ignoring positive evidence
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Flights are always delayed, reliable options are almost nonexistent

core_conflict.wish: Longs to stay close to siblings, and to gain a sense of security in predictable, controllable environments
core_conflict.fear: Fearing uncertainty leading to loss of control and being trapped, thus damaging relationships or disappointing people
defense_goal: By maintaining high control and meticulous planning to reduce uncertainty
By Avoiding travel to prevent possible loss of control and Anxiety

object_relations.self_representation: An Anxiety sufferer who needs to be perfect and punctual to be accepted
object_relations.object_representation: Experienced as siblings / relatives who have expectations of me but may be disappointed because I am late

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When counseling focuses on the uncertainty of travel or when invited to identify and express feelings such as Anxiety, helplessness
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Tending to believe that making a more thorough plan can control the problem, discussing emotions will make things more uncertain, rational solutions are more 'effective'
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Adopting a calm, analytical tone, emphasizing data and steps, avoiding in-depth expression of feelings such as Fear, helplessness; answering through problem breakdown and solution evaluation.

manifestations: Feeling intense Anxiety when facing choices and unpredictability in travel
Hopes to control outcomes through a perfect plan
Due to canceling or postponing family visits, leading to Relationship tension with siblings
Rarely participates in face-to-face interaction with family

positive_force: Willing to seek help and maintain a positive attitude
Having Social support from siblings and friends (although not yet communicating in depth)
negative_force: Highly Fearing the future and uncertainty
Thinking tendency of catastrophizing and predicting the future (believing flights will inevitably be delayed)
Black-and-white punctuality demands lead to avoidance behavior
Stress rises markedly in travel-planning situations; often cancels or postpones trips

target_behavior.behavior: Avoids traveling (cancels or postpones visiting siblings)
antecedent: Making or about to make travel plans
Receives siblings' invitation or arranges a specific date
Checking uncertain information such as flight delays or weather
target_behavior.core_reason: Catastrophic cognition about uncertainty and delays, and the belief that 'failing to arrive exactly on schedule as planned equals failure'; long-term Fear of the future intensifying the need for control
target_behavior.function: Avoiding uncertainty and Anxiety, relieving stress in the short term
target_behavior.consequence: Relationship tension with siblings, reducing the joy of travel and activities, Daily life affected
